title: Transport of the normalized localization equation along a representative isomorphism
statement: Given two cochain complexes P and Q and an isomorphism between their derived images, an equality of the normalized quotient section computation maps at P transports to the corresponding equality at Q.

source.place: Tags 06YS and 06YU; naturality and cancellation in the resolving-class localization descent.

proof_origin.place: Retired after replacing its sole caller with the direct cochain-level naturality argument along the actual resolution augmentation. The ordinary scalar-extension target is not assumed to descend to the derived category, so no arbitrary derived-isomorphism transport is asserted.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration for this specialized quotient section computation transport.
